FIX IS HUMAN-REQUIRED (protected path). Minimal root-cause fix: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions[bot]"` to the `with:` block of each anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (standard-tier, deep Fable-5, deep Opus-fallback). Adding it to all three is the robust choice; strictly only the two deep steps are reachable today (escalation always dispatches tier=deep), but standard could be bot-dispatched by a future change. Scope to the specific bot login, NOT '*': this is a PUBLIC repo and the action's docs warn '*' can let external Apps invoke the action with prompts they control. Confirmed against the action's own source today (cloned anthropics/claude-code-action@v1): action.yml documents `allowed_bots` as 'Comma-separated list of allowed bot usernames, or ''*'' to allow all bots. Empty string (default) allows no bots.'; and src/github/validation/actor.ts `isAllowedBot()` lowercases and strips the trailing `[bot]` from BOTH the list entry and the actor before comparing — so `github-actions[bot]` and the bare `github-actions` used in #430's patch are exactly equivalent, both matching the `github-actions[bot]` actor.

The workflow `allowed_bots` line is the smallest correct fix.
